task: Trip readiness review for Japan. Write a pre-departure checklist from the supplied records only: the entry requirement and documents to prepare, what to pack for each recorded season, and how to get around with each recorded transit option. One item per record. Where a record is missing or a rule must be confirmed, say to check Smartraveller or the official source.

evidence.title: Japan — entry requirement
evidence.text: Records supplied: 2 of 2 weather notes, 2 of 2 transit options. Visa requirement on record: visa-free. Entry notes: Short-stay tourist entry for Australian passport holders. Visit Japan Web pre-registration speeds up immigration and customs.

evidence.title: Japan — weather: Spring (Mar-May)
evidence.text: Season: Spring (Mar-May). Mild days and heavy cherry blossom crowds. Pack layers because inland evenings stay cold well into April.

evidence.title: Japan — weather: Summer (Jun-Aug)
evidence.text: Season: Summer (Jun-Aug). Hot and humid with the tsuyu rains through June, and typhoon disruption building from late August.

evidence.title: Japan — transit: rail
evidence.text: Transit type: rail. A Japan Rail Pass covers most Shinkansen services between major cities and is cheapest bought before arrival.

evidence.title: Japan — transit: metro
evidence.text: Transit type: metro. Tokyo Metro and Toei lines accept Suica or Pasmo IC cards, which also work on buses and in convenience stores.

plan.objective: Plan a pre-departure checklist for Japan based on the provided evidence.

steps.description: Gather required documents, including the Australian passport and any necessary visas (if required) to check against Smartraveller or the official source.
Pack clothing and accessories suitable for each season: Spring (Mar-May), Summer (Jun-Aug), and any other seasons mentioned in the evidence.
Research and purchase a Japan Rail Pass for rail travel between major cities.
Understand the transit options and payment methods for metro travel in Tokyo, including Suica or Pasmo IC cards.

success_criteria: The checklist includes all required documents for entry into Japan.
The checklist includes clothing and accessories suitable for each season.
The Japan Rail Pass is purchased and ready for use.
The Worker understands the transit options and payment methods for metro travel in Tokyo.
